Jalapeno Cheese Bread (Bread Machine Version)
By: Mrs. M
Published: Sunday, April 25, 2010 - 7:22am

Ingredients




1 1/8 cups luke  warm water
1 teaspoon salt
2 Tblsp sugar
1/2 cup shredded Monterrey jack cheese
3 Tblsp chopped Jalapeno peppers (more or less depending on your heat preference)
3 cups bread flour (I used all purpose as that is what I had on hand)
1/2 Tblsp active dry yeast

Preparation

1 Place ingredients in your bread machine according to the manufacturer directions. Set machine to 1-1/2 lb loaf on light-white setting. Press start and in a few hours you'll have a fresh tasty loaf of bread.
